name: Mudan Kashidashi Kanojo
source:
Next to me is my first girlfriend, whom I've been dating for six months.

"Hey, today...do you want to come over?" "Oh, I'm sorry. I have something to do today too.

I was thinking of having a party to celebrate our six-month anniversary, but she turned me down.
This kind of thing has been happening a lot lately.
She has something to do, and we can't always find the time for each other.
But...it can't be helped. I smile and say, "See you next time."

But I see a pair of earrings that are not hers or my taste, and they are shiny and mysterious,
I don't know why it makes me uneasy....

Translated from [url=https://store-jp.nintendo.com/list/software/70010000067349.html]Nintendo Store[/url]
translation:
我旁边是我的第一个女朋友，我已经和她约会了六个月。

“喂，今天……你要过来吗？” “哦，抱歉，我今天也有事。”

我本来想举办一个聚会来庆祝我们结婚六个月周年纪念日，但她拒绝了我。
近来这样的事情屡见不鲜。
她有事要做，我们总是抽不出时间在一起。
但是……这也是没办法的事。我微笑着说：“下次见。”

但我看到一对耳环既不符合她的口味，也不符合我的口味，闪闪发亮，神秘莫测，
我不知道为什么我会感到不安……

翻译自 [url=https://store-jp.nintendo.com/list/software/70010000067349.html]任天堂商店[/url]
